title: Profusely
summary: PROFU'SELY, adverb Lavishly; prodigally; as an income profusely expended. 1. With exuberance; with rich abundance. The earth is profusely adorned with flowers; ornaments may be too profusely scattered

inlines.v: PROFU'SELY, adverb Lavishly; prodigally; as an income profusely expended. 1. With exuberance; with rich abundance. The earth is profusely adorned with flowers; ornaments may be too profusely scattered over a building.
